english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something builds up impressively but ends weakly.

examples.english: The movie ended anticlimactically after a brilliant buildup.
examples.traditional: 套戲前面鋪排得好精彩，最後卻虎頭蛇尾咁收科。
